footer: You are receiving this email because of activity on your Palsya account. Questions? Contact {support}.

reset.subject: Reset your Palsya password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Palsya account. Choose a new password with the button below. The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email — your password will not change.

changed.subject: Your Palsya password was changed
changed.preheader: If this wasn't you, contact support.
changed.heading: Your password was changed
changed.body: The password for your Palsya account was changed on {when, date, long} at {when, time, short}. You have been signed out on your other devices.
changed.notYou: If this wasn't you, contact support straight away at {support}.

invite.subject: {role, select, admin {You have been invited to administer Palsya} other {You have been invited to Palsya as a clinician}}
invite.preheader: Accept the invitation and set your password.
invite.heading: {role, select, admin {Join Palsya as an administrator} other {Join Palsya as a clinician}}
invite.body: {inviter} has invited you to Palsya {role, select, admin {as an administrator} other {as a clinician}}. Accept the invitation to set your name and password.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
